# MONO DISTRICT.

> Managed Virtual Assistant Agency placing and overseeing dedicated Social Media Managers, Graphic Designers, Video Editors, and Web Designers/Developers through one Account Manager.

MONO DISTRICT. is a managed virtual assistant (VA) agency. We vet, assign, and manage specialist VAs across four core digital disciplines so business owners get consistent creative and technical output without recruiting freelancers or managing multiple chats.

## Core Facts
- **Agency Type**: Managed Virtual Assistant (VA) Agency
- **Specialists Placed**: Social Media Managers, Graphic Designers, Video Editors, Web Designers / Developers
- **Communication Model**: Dedicated Account Manager (instant to 1-hour same-day reply) relaying briefs and revisions; optional direct VA chat monitored by the Account Manager
- **Minimum Commitment**: 3 hours/day (15 hours/week)
- **Pricing & Billing**: Custom hourly or monthly rates based on daily hours and specialist role(s); invoiced via card or bank transfer
- **Contract Length**: Flexible and terminable anytime with zero long-term lock-in
- **Confidentiality**: Upfront NDA signed before onboarding
- **Specialist Replacement**: Prompt replacement at no extra cost if a VA is not the right fit
- **Contact & Consultation**: [Book a free 30-minute consultation](https://calendly.com/support-monodistrict/30min) | support.monodistrict@gmail.com
